title: Work trace record
description: One record of a Gradle work trace. plan.jsonl holds plan records; work.jsonl holds task records. Each file is JSON Lines: one record per line. Empty arrays are omitted at any depth; a missing array means empty. Flags that are normally false are omitted and present only as true.

buildTreeTaskPath.description: A task identity: the path of the task's build in the build tree joined with the task path, where the root build's ':' collapses. ':app:compileJava' is a task of the root build; ':included:lib:jar' is ':lib:jar' in the included build 'included'.

buildPath.description: The path of a build in the build tree: ':' for the root build, ':included' for an included build.

location.description: A file or directory. Relative to the root build directory with '/' separators when inside it ('' is the root directory itself); otherwise an absolute path in native form.

planRecord.description: The task graph of one build in the root work graph, written when the graph is calculated. One per build in the build tree.

requestedTaskPaths.description: The tasks of this build that were requested on the command line or are default tasks.

excludedTaskPaths.description: Tasks of this build excluded with -x. They have no task record and are not in 'tasks'; an edge naming one of them is a leaf.

tasks.description: Every task of this build that was scheduled, whether or not it later ran. Sorted by id.

dependencies.description: Explicit and input-inferred dependencies merged; the task record splits them by kind.

taskRecord.description: One task that reached execution in the root work graph.

implementation.description: Fully qualified name of the task class.

inputs.description: Input file properties with their roots. Omitted when the task has no file inputs or when inputsCapturingSkipped is present.

inputsCapturingSkipped.description: Present only when the execution engine did not fingerprint the task's inputs; 'inputs' is then absent.

scheduling.description: Why the task is in the graph. A task is scheduled through a chain of explicitDependsOn, inputDependencies and finalizerOf edges from a requested task; the ordering constraints never cause scheduling.

requested.description: Present only for tasks requested on the command line or default tasks.

explicitDependsOn.description: Edges declared with dependsOn or by task dependency objects that are not input file properties.

inputDependencies.description: Per input file property, the tasks that build its files.

inputDependenciesError.description: Present when the input dependencies could not be resolved; explains why.

roots.description: The property's root files and directories. Files under a directory root are not listed.

files.description: Regular files under the location, relative to it with '/' separators, as they exist after the task's turn in the build. '' means the location itself is the file. Omitted when nothing is there.
